title: Scenario pool runs the question pool over the kb, router, hook and web arms at two effort levels and reports tokens per right answer by kind and arm
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run pool [--arms A,B] [--kinds K] [--effort low,default] [--reps N] runs every pool row (the public file, and the query-log file when present) as a fresh claude -p per question on the arms haiku-5-5, haiku-4-5 and sonnet-5-5 (kb, pinned ids), router (kb_ask.py), hook (the kb: hook, no model) and, on the rows whose kind is in a subset list, web-haiku-5-5 and web-sonnet-5-5, each kb arm at effort low and at the model's default through --effort; it records per run input, cache_read, cache_write, effective_input (the per-model weights of ST-37c3f5l5), out, start_ctx, pack_tokens (the size of every kb tool result in the stream), tool_calls, turns, wall_s, cost and checks, and per cell the derived fixed_share (start_ctx over input) and tokens_per_right (effective_input over checks passed); bench_report.py prints a tokens-per-right table by kind and arm, a fixed-share table by arm, an effort table (low against default per model) and the Haiku 5.5 against Haiku 4.5 pair as new-model prints its pair, between bench: markers of a new section of kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md that report --check verifies, and report --check exits 1 naming a bench: table marker whose scenario has no rows in benchmarks.csv, so the pool section's markers fail the check until ST-ji32ouga's record exists; a test feeds the scenario a synthetic stream and a three-row pool and checks the rows and the derived cells, and one plants a marker with no rows; kb/_self/tools.md has the command's row

gates.question: The goal makes the pool section's bench: markers fail report --check until ST-ji32ouga's record exists, but report --check is this item's own done check: when do the section's table markers land?
options: Build the scenario, the bench_report.py tables and report --check's no-rows rule now (proved by a planted-marker test); the section of benchmarks.md gets its setup text and Counting method now and its bench: table markers land with ST-ji32ouga's record
Land the markers now and change this item's check (operator-only)
gates.recommendation: Build the scenario, the bench_report.py tables and report --check's no-rows rule now (proved by a planted-marker test); the section of benchmarks.md gets its setup text and Counting method now and its bench: table markers land with ST-ji32ouga's record

gates.question: The goal divides effective input by checks passed to get the per-right figure of a cell, and a pool row can hold several checks: what counts as one right answer?
options: A run whose checks all pass is one right answer; the cell figure is the effective input summed over its runs, divided by those runs; the passed and total checks stay as their own count
Each passed check is one right answer, so a run passing two of three checks counts twice
gates.recommendation: A run whose checks all pass is one right answer; the cell figure is the effective input summed over its runs, divided by those runs; the passed and total checks stay as their own count
gates.answer: A run whose checks all pass is one right answer; the cell figure is the effective input summed over its runs, divided by those runs; the passed and total checks stay as their own count

gates.question: The goal runs the web arms on rows whose kind is in a subset list but does not name the list or the web arms' effort: which kinds, and which effort levels?
options: Web arms run the kinds fact, csv_fact, multi, synthesis, offkb, snippet and false_good (questions a web search can answer), at the model's default effort only; the kb arms run at both levels
Web arms run every kind and both effort levels
gates.recommendation: Web arms run the kinds fact, csv_fact, multi, synthesis, offkb, snippet and false_good (questions a web search can answer), at the model's default effort only; the kb arms run at both levels
gates.answer: Web arms run the kinds fact, csv_fact, multi, synthesis, offkb, snippet and false_good (questions a web search can answer), at the model's default effort only; the kb arms run at both levels

notes: Effort on a -p run: --effort LEVEL or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL (Claude Code model-config page, live docs 2026-10-08): levels low..max on Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, default medium; Haiku 4.5 does not support effort, so its arm runs one level and the effort table marks it. pack_tokens: count the characters of each kb tool_result in the stream and convert with the run's own ratio (input tokens of the request that carried it minus the request before), or the result event's usage when it names the tool result; state the method in the report's Counting. Reuse agent_bench.py's arms, checks and the stream scorer; the hook arm runs the kb: hook command as querylog-hooks does and records 0 model tokens and its wall time. Reps and arms are flags so ST-ji32ouga's gate answer selects the set without code changes. The existing navigation scenario's --arm and same-day replacement rules apply (one record per day per arm). report --check passes before the work: it pins every existing table. After this story lands it fails on the new pool markers until the record of ST-ji32ouga is written, which is that story's failing check.
